description: This file contains the documentation and source code reference for the Opencart System Library Cache File class, which implements file-based caching mechanisms. It includes methods for constructing the cache object, retrieving, setting, and deleting cache entries, and managing cache lifecycle.

classes.name: Opencart.System.Library.Cache.File
classes.description: Class implementing file-based cache storage with methods for cache management, including construct, get, set, delete, and destruct.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache object with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key, returning mixed data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache under the specified key with an optional expiration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cached item by key.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the cache object is destroyed.
